Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Review cycle: blackout windows & redaction protocol (draft)

Team —

Attached is a first draft of the operational controls we want for this year’s performance cycle:

- Blackout calendar (who can access review docs and when)
- Redaction guidance for sensitive commentary (what to redact vs what to escalate)
- Manager training outline (short outline so managers know what to expect)

Key asks: please review for accuracy and operational risk by EOD Friday (Aug 6). Things I want to surface now:

1) We need a firm blackout window during which no changes to reviewer comments are permitted (proposed: Oct 11–18).
2) A lightweight redaction workflow so managers can flag items that require People/Legal review without leaking PII.
3) Confirmation from Legal on phrasing for the redaction template we’ll share with employees.

Attachments: [Attachment: blackout_calendar_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Attachment: redaction_guidelines_v1.docx (DOCX, 56KB)]

I’ll pull together a consolidated action plan once I have comments. Marta — can you confirm availability to run a 60–90 minute manager training the week before the blackout starts?

Thanks,

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of People & Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Review cycle: blackout windows & redaction protocol (draft)

Thanks Vivek — quick pass below. I made inline comments on the redaction doc (see attached manager training outline as well). High-level:

- Blackout window: agree with Oct 11–18 but we should add a two-day buffer on either side for emergency corrections (logs only; no content edits).
- Redaction workflow: add a short form for managers to submit redaction requests (min fields: employee, reviewer, reason, redaction excerpt).
- Escalation SLA: PeopleOps to respond within 48 hours during the blackout; Legal to be looped for anything with potential regulatory exposure.

Attachment: [Attachment: manager_training_outline.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Also propose a brief manager office hour schedule the week of Oct 4 so managers can get one‑on‑one help before the blackout. Will mark areas in the doc.

-Neha

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the consolidated action plan and the calendar we’ll publish to managers and ICs next week. Key decisions:

- Blackout window: Oct 11 00:00 PT through Oct 18 23:59 PT (read-only + audit logs Oct 9–20).
- Redaction workflow: one-click manager request form + PeopleOps triage (48-hour SLA) + Legal review for items flagged as regulatory risk.
- Manager training: three sessions Oct 5–7; office hours Oct 4–8. Trainer: Marta (Talent Advisors).
- Calibration: read-only for 72 hours after calibration closes (comp runs on day +3).

Next steps for each owner:
- Neha: publish manager guidance, create form, and schedule office hours.
- Aditya/Legal: finalize template language by Aug 16.
- Laura: confirm calibration dates with eng leadership by Aug 13.
- Marta: finalize slides and confirm trainers by Aug 13.
